title: Streamable HTTP transport
description: One HTTP POST per message to a single endpoint, answered with a JSON object or a request-scoped SSE stream, and carrying the required `Mcp-Method` and `Mcp-Name` headers.
question: Can the framework talk to a remote server on this revision's terms?
why: Every remote MCP server uses this transport, and 2026-07-28 changed it substantially: sessions and the `Mcp-Session-Id` header are gone, SSE resumability is gone, and two new headers are required. An adapter written for the old shape may connect and still be non-conformant.
known_issues: Measured with the official MCP conformance suite 0.1.16, whose client scenarios are tagged 2025-11-25.

Also measured by `scripts/measure_transports.py`, which asks every renderer for the same definitions, probe answers and result calls over stdio and over Streamable HTTP behind the recording proxy; the cell combines that comparison with the suite's `tools_call` scenario.

notes.crewai-native: CrewAI 1.15.26, native `crewai.mcp` client (`Agent(mcps=[...])`, not the `crewai_tools.MCPServerAdapter` row): the session opens and lists the same definitions as stdio, but on the pinned Python 3.11 every tool call fails. `MCPNativeTool._run` calls `asyncio.run` when no event loop is running, which is the case for `BaseTool.run` and for a synchronous crew, and the fresh `MCPClient` it opens for the call then fails to close its `streamablehttp_client` transport: `RuntimeError: Error executing MCP tool text_content: Error during MCP client disconnect: no running event loop`, for all 18 calls at both boundaries. The server did answer each `tools/call`; the result is lost on the client. A standalone repro of the same call succeeds on Python 3.12 and 3.13, and on 3.11 when the tool runs inside a running event loop; neither was measured by the instrument. The tool names also change with the transport: each is named after the URL's host, port and path (`127_0_0_1_<port>_mcp_search_records`), so the name differs from the stdio one and from run to run as the port changes.
